so_what: Seven teams are 4-5 chasing six spots, and pauldag, Sladsous, Stipe and DadKing hold the money while mfkr fell to 12 FAAB and ENOTS and DiaperDutyDaddy are trade-only.
pauldag (4-5, 93 FAAB) lost Stevenson for weeks with A.J. Brown still out, so pauldag is the likeliest big bidder on New England backs and the most motivated trade buyer.
Stipe (5-4, 89 FAAB) loses Jacobs for up to three weeks and Singletary's role when Skattebo returns Thursday, which makes Stipe the natural bidder on Kaleb Johnson.
bwalsh89 (4-5, 64 FAAB) loses Nacua until Week 15 at the earliest, so a WR hole now sits on a roster with money to spend.
mfkr's Jefferson (3 of 11, 58 yards) and DadKing's Hockenson both lose ceiling while Murray is week-to-week, and mfkr has only 12 FAAB to cover it.
DadKing gains through Lamb (Ferguson out for weeks) and Rice (Worthy day-to-day) but Henderson is still undiagnosed, and 81 FAAB lets DadKing buy RB depth.
DiaperDutyDaddy's McBride keeps volume with Wilson out but loses QB quality to rookie Carson Beck, and at 2 FAAB the team can only trade.
ENOTS (Waddle, Worthy) and StoneBone69 (Evans out another week) both have WR problems and no money, so their fixes come by trade.
